title: Assert every mocked call in autolog tests
answers: mock not asserted in crewai test
how to write crewai autolog test with patch
repo python test guideline mocked call verification
end-to-end crewai test passes without calling mocked api
body:
Convention: Every mock or patch in tests must be verified. A reviewer asked for this, citing the repository Python test guideline.
In tests/crewai/test_crewai_autolog.py, the patch of litellm.completion is captured with `as mock_completion` and asserted with mock_completion.assert_called() before the trace is checked.
Why: without the assertion, an end-to-end trace test can pass even if the code path never reached the mocked completion API.
applies: Applies to all new tests in tests/crewai/ and other autolog test files that use patch or Mock.
says: Autologging integration tests pass even when simulated model requests are skipped
Ensure automatic logging test cases confirm the simulated provider service was called
Require test runs for automatic logging to verify all simulated external calls
search: All autolog tests using patch or Mock, such as tests/crewai/test_crewai_autolog.py, must explicitly verify mocked calls with assertions like assert_called(). Without explicit mock verification, end-to-end trace tests can falsely pass when the code path never invokes the mocked API. Applies to all new test cases in tests/crewai/ and other autologging test modules using unittest.mock.
